verdict.rationale: Galileo's docs show that Cost is a tracked metric. Its alerting can aggregate Cost over a time window and notify when cost is higher than expected, which is a thin, indirect signal of cost monitoring. Nothing documents dashboard views of cost or tokens. missing for 10: token-usage tracking, cost/token breakdown per request, per-model breakdown, time-period dashboard visualizations, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can see cost and token usage per request, model, and time period in dashboards

citations.quote: Each alert configuration includes: a metric e.g. Cost, Correctness, Context Adherence; an aggregation function...; a threshold e.g. < 0.5; a time window e.g. 1 hour
Galileo enables you to get alerted whenever unexpected things happen. For example: Your cost is higher than expected
